new_processes.name: Meter accounting arrangement set-up
new_processes.definition: Requesting an accounting arrangement at a meter so volumes can be moved between contracts.

new_processes.name: RC report charge review
new_processes.definition: Asking cost centre owners to review monthly charges on their RC reports and correct errors before journal entries.

new_processes.name: Transport rate verification
new_processes.definition: Checking that transport rates on usage tickets match the rate matrix so the desk estimate is right.

new_processes.name: Intercompany variance clearing
new_processes.definition: Finding and clearing volume variances or one-sided deals between affiliates before month end.

new_processes.name: Oasis PMA clearing
new_processes.definition: Clearing pipeline measurement adjustments on Oasis caused by missing or incorrect rates.

new_processes.name: Salary survey questionnaire
new_processes.definition: Collecting completed salary survey questionnaires from department heads.
